title: 134 free APIs from 40+ companies just killed the "AI is expensive" excuse
description:
134 free APIs from 40+ companies just killed the "AI is expensive" excuse

🔥 Here's the full details and link ya'll!

https://the-ai-surfer.remixr.io/use-free-apis-for-anything?ref=yt

Here's what's happening that most people are missing:

1. There's a list of 134 free APIs from over 40 different providers, including Gemini, Grok, and NVIDIA, and every single one comes with a permanent free tier most developers never bother to look for

2. While everyone else hits rate limits and reaches for a credit card, you can run the exact same models for $0, the only thing standing between you and it is knowing where to click

3. Setup takes one click right inside Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex, because all three let you override the default provider with any custom API endpoint and key

The wild part? Most people assume paywalls are just the cost of building with AI, when your editor genuinely doesn't care where the model comes from at all.

This isn't future tech. It's happening right now. Get the full list plus the exact copy-paste setup for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, link is in the description.

#AI #FreeAPIs #Cursor #ClaudeCode #Codex
